allprojects.name: Found Footage Creep
allprojects.description: FFC is a database app of information related to found footage movies. Here you'll be able to find a big set of movies of found footage genre. In total there are more than 1,000 movies, shorts and videos. You can create your own watchlist in order to never forget your favourite found footage movies and you can keep track of the ones you like.

allprojects.name: CoolReads
allprojects.description: CoolReads is a web application inspired by Goodreads, and it was designed for managing personal libraries, track the reading progress, consult book informations and connect with other reader lovers. The aim was to build a platform more user-friendly, easier to manage collections and more social engaging.

allprojects.name: Virtual Map of Braga
allprojects.description: A web application featuring a virtual map of Braga's streets and their historical context. This application features a set of features that allow you to add and remove locations, cross-navigation through streets, and search for street's information.

allprojects.name: PackMyBag
allprojects.description: PackMyBag is a clothing rental service directly at the travel destination, eliminating the need to carry luggage. The solution promotes sustainability and convenience for travelers.
